en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic city gate complex with a crenellated stone tower, adjoining half‑timbered and tiled‑roof buildings, and a rounded gatehouse structure with an arched entrance. Trees frame the scene in the foreground and background. In the upper left corner printed in red Gothic‑style lettering is the caption identifying the place as Naumburg on the Saale and the specific gate as Marientor.
